name: Burning Blood
summary: In Stormwind, Grimand Elmore puts Furen Longbeard’s smithing methods to the test. To try them at his own forge, he needs burning blood and a burning rock from Duskwood.

sections.title: A Reluctant Experiment
sections.body:
Grimand Elmore is one of the Alliance’s finest armorers. He seldom believes another smith can surpass his methods. Yet Furen Longbeard’s unusual discoveries have stirred his professional curiosity, and Grimand agrees to make a piece of armor using them.

For the work, he needs strange, volatile materials from the dark reaches of the south. They will quench and temper the metal to his exact requirements. Ordinary water and common coals will not do.

sections.title: The Horrors of Roland's Doom
sections.body:
Grimand sends you to Roland’s Doom, an abandoned mine in Duskwood. Savage Nightbane worgen have overrun its tunnels, and burning ichor pulses in their cursed veins.

He needs vials of their burning blood and a rare flaming core called a burning rock. Gutspill, leader of the pack, carries it. Bring both scorching materials back so Grimand can test Furen’s methods at the forge.

faq.answer: Grimand Elmore is a respected master armorer in Stormwind’s Dwarven District. He works with other craftsmen to equip the city’s defenders and trains aspiring warriors in the weight and strength of proper battle plate.

faq.q: Why does Grimand want burning blood and a burning rock?
faq.answer: Grimand wants to test an armorcrafting technique developed by Furen Longbeard. The burning blood and burning rock provide the supernatural heat needed to forge and temper specialized armor plates.

faq.q: Where do I find the Nightbane worgen carrying these materials?
faq.answer: You can find the materials at Roland’s Doom, an abandoned mine in southeastern Duskwood, southwest of Darkshire. Nightbane worgen fill its tunnels and carry the burning blood.
Gutspill, a powerful leader among the Nightbane worgen, carries the burning rock deep within Roland’s Doom.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Grimand Elmore and Furen Longbeard?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is Grimand Elmore’s former student. Grimand is usually skeptical of outside ideas, but Furen’s latest armorcrafting methods have persuaded him to test them firsthand.

faq.q: What happens after returning the blood and rock?
faq.answer: After receiving the fiery reagents, Grimand begins forging armor to test Furen’s methods. He promises the finished piece to the adventurer who gathered the materials.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can brave Duskwood’s cursed beasts for Grimand’s experiment and earn uniquely tempered armor made for the front lines.
As a blacksmith, you can watch Grimand test his former student Furen’s methods with rare metals and quenching agents.
As an Alliance member, you can recover reagents from Roland’s Doom, helping check the worgen threat in Duskwood and supply Stormwind’s armories with new defensive methods.
